narrative: The draft codifies an active federal-state collision: a three-year preemption of state frontier-development laws targeting California's AB 2013 and SB 942, plus a partial federal ceiling, while preserving use and deployment rules. That densifies the U.S. legs of the multi-front regulatory map, and the immediate split over preemption confirms the structural tension the anchor anticipates.
remaining_gap: Purely a U.S. governance move with no EU-side action, so the European front of the three-front thesis stays untouched today.
